**Finding submitted: missing (fallback-level insert).**

- **Investigation:** Article XIV (p0642–p0678) sets out a complete wind-down, but every obligation flows to Array — Ono transitions clinical/pre-clinical studies (p0646–p0647), continues distribution (p0649–p0654), assigns Regulatory Filings and hands over all Data and Ono Know-How (p0656, p0659), supplies customer data (p0660), grants licences (p0661), returns/destroys Array Materials and Confidential Information (p0662), assigns marks, domains and Sublicensee contracts (p0665–p0666). Article X contains no return-of-Confidential-Information mechanic, and searches for "Array shall return", "destroy" and "transition assistance" surfaced nothing Array-side. Section 9's technology transfer (p0508) is a mid-term Ono right, not an exit right.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the only arguably responsive text (14.2(a)(iv), mutual "Diligent Efforts to cooperate") is confined to transitioning the Product back to Array during a redacted Wind-down Period, with no assistance duration and no data export deadline; and 14.2 is triggered only "In case of termination", not expiration.
- **Cure:** one new clause (x) after p0667 — expiry-or-termination trigger, at least 90 days' Array transition assistance, and export of Ono's data within 30 days. Preferred-only extras (six months, then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion) were deliberately omitted as outside the selected fallback checklist.
